steps.text: Bring a rope, a shovel and 7 red apples.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope, Shovel, Key 3620, 7 Red Apples (for Key 3666).

steps.text: Go down into the Ancient Temple north of Thais, two floors.
steps.source: Go to the Ancient Temple, north of Thais (Mapper Coords 126.100, 125.171, 7). Go down two levels.

steps.text: Head as far north as you can and go down two floors to the rotworms.
steps.source: Head as far north as you can go. Go down to the level with the Rotworms.

steps.text: Follow the path east and south and go down the ladder (rotworms, poison spiders, orcs and orc spearmen).
steps.source: Follow this path to the east and south, and go down the ladder.

steps.text: Through the poison fields (antidote or destroy field) and down another level.
steps.source: On this level, there will be a lot of Poison Fields. You can either run through them and then use Antidote, or you can use Destroy Field to clear a path. Go down another level.

steps.text: Follow the path east and north (poison spiders, minotaurs) and go down the hole (cyclopes).
steps.source: Follow this path to the east and north. Be careful of Minotaurs. Go down the hole that is circled on the map. You will face a couple Cyclopes down this hole.

steps.text: Head south down the leftmost passage and go up the hole to a small room, and up again.
steps.source: Head south down the left most passage. Go up the hole to a small room and up again to another room.

steps.text: Go to the end of this passage and down the hole to a small room, and down again.
steps.source: Here go to the end of this passage and down the hole to a small room and down again.

steps.text: Go down into Mintwallin.
steps.source: The first thing you need to do is go to the Prison in Mintwallin and talk to A Prisoner.

steps.text: Key 3620 is in the drawers of the barracks south of Markwin (minotaurs, minotaur guards, archers and mages).
steps.source: To get the key to his room, you need to go to the barracks, south of Markwin.

steps.text: Go up to the prison.
steps.source: Go to the Prison in Mintwallin and talk to A Prisoner.

steps.text: Open the prison door with key 3620; talk to A Prisoner through the bars.
steps.source: To get the key to his room, you need to go to the barracks, south of Markwin.

steps.text: He takes the 7 apples and gives you key 3666.
steps.source: Ask him for the riddle. The correct answer is "PD-D-KS-P-PD". You receive silver Key 3666 after giving the apples.

steps.text: Leave Mintwallin the way you came in.
steps.source: This is the path to the Mad Mage room from the surface. You will walk past this room on your way to Mintwallin.

steps.text: Head south, west, north, then right towards the level door and go down the stairs: a dragon, a giant spider, a beholder, demon skeletons, a ghoul, a scorpion and a skeleton.
steps.source: Head south then west then north then take a right heading towards the level door. Head down the stairs BUT BEWARE!!!! There is at least one dragon, one giant spider, one Bonelord, 3 demon skeletons, one ghoul, one scorpion, and one skeleton.

steps.text: Clear the room, head south-east and open the door with key 3666.
steps.source: After clearing this room head to the southeast and through the locked door, using a key taken from A Prisoner.

steps.text: Go up the ladder and face the demon skeletons.
steps.source: Once you are through the door, go up the ladder and face 3 Demon Skeletons.

steps.text: The rewards are in this room: the stone skin amulet,
steps.source: The rewards are in chests in this room.

steps.text: the hat of the mad,
steps.source: The rewards are in chests in this room.

steps.text: and the star amulet.
steps.source: The rewards are in chests in this room.
